summary: A union member takes the campaign’s labor job while leaders in the local movement remain cool to the candidate.
realLife: Peters identified Greyhound driver Dan Moroney as the Kennedy campaign’s county labor co-chair.
gates: The worker belongs to a union and holds a campaign role.
inGame: needs: a campaign assignment linked to a worker's existing job schedule and association membership.

turns.what: The driver shares the campaign desk with another volunteer.
turns.pulledBy: The bus schedule leaves the driver free on only some evenings.
turns.writesBack: The rota names who covers each night.

turns.what: The driver declines the chair and stays on as an occasional volunteer.
turns.pulledBy: The route schedule rules out regular office hours.
turns.writesBack: The campaign records an open chair and a volunteer with limited availability.
